ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "In Progress"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Ready For Review") ), NOT($Permission.Set_RSD_Account_Plan_Status), NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Completed"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Active"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Inactive") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only Authorized RSD users can change the Account Plan status to In Progress or Ready for Review.
